conditions.instruction: Do a reflective white calibration on the instrument itself
Do a transmissive white calibration on the instrument itself
Do a transmissive dark calibration on the instrument itself
Place the instrument on its reflective white reference
conditions.reference_id_holds: The expected white reference identifier, held by the driver, not read from the reference placed

conditions.instruction: Click the instrument down on its reflective white reference
conditions.reference_id_holds: The expected white reference identifier, held by the driver, not read from the reference placed

conditions.instruction: Place the instrument on a light trap, or in the dark and distant from any surface
Place the instrument on its black gloss reference
Place the cap on the instrument, or place it on a dark surface or on the calibration reference
Place the ambient adapter and cap on the instrument, or place it on the calibration reference
Set the instrument sensor to its calibration position
Place the instrument on its transmissive white source
Block the transmission path with the appropriate transmissive blocking
Display a 100% white test patch for the instrument
Display an 80% white test patch for the instrument
Display a grey test patch for the instrument
Display a darker grey test patch for the instrument
Display a lighter grey test patch for the instrument
Change the filter on the instrument
The driver has a message for the operator

calibration.display_level: A fraction of full white for the patch the client must display; present only for `display_patch` conditions, and never to be invented by the client

calibration_setup.document: GretagMacbeth Spectrolino / SpectroScan / SpectroScan T Operating Manual
calibration_setup.quote: After having inserted the last position, an absolute white calibration of the Spectrolino is performed automatically
calibration_setup.text: Nothing to place: the SpectroScan calibrates the Spectrolino on its white reference by itself.

descriptor.capability_source: instrument capabilities(), decoded; baseline_native_mode reports exact initialized-state checks when observed; acquisition confirms the requested configuration at bind time

instructions.detail: Present the declared external display stimulus and keep it unchanged during the frequency measurement
Prepare the requested strip, then continue
Position the sample or measurement optics, then continue
Set up what the instrument asks for to calibrate, then continue
Do what the instrument asks for to calibrate; it continues by itself
Place the chart on the table
Sight a named fiducial so the table can locate the sheet
The sensor, dial, diffuser or adapter is not where this step needs it. Move it, then continue; the step is tried once more

native_diagnostics.scope: Auxiliary stderr provenance; no scientific setting changes

calibration_setup.quote: /* For SpectroScan, move to the white reference in slot 1 and lower */
calibration_setup.text: The table moves to its mounted white reference automatically when calibration is needed; keep that reference installed.

calibration_setup.quote: *calc = inst_calc_change_filter;
calibration_setup.text: A filter mismatch can ask for the filter named by the driver. Emissive calibration uses the NO filter.

operator_setup.document: GretagMacbeth Spectrolino / SpectroScan / SpectroScan T Operating Manual
operator_setup.quote: Point 1: Mount the white reference (17) from the Spectrolino into the upper slot (38) of the SpectroScan.
operator_setup.text: Before power-on, mount the Spectrolino's white reference in the table's upper slot; lay the chart (1.5 mm at most) on the electrostatic surface.

assessment.text: The native route measures reflection. Patch isolation and operator placement still follow the instrument's setup.
